_comment: Example ck:test --tdd --prepare artifact. Written before ck:cook implements anything; ck:cook's preflight (Step 1) checks for status RED_READY here before starting a --tdd phase. Not a JSON-Schema document — an annotated canonical instance.
_status_blocked: A candidate test failed for a reason other than missing implementation (e.g. a syntax error in the test itself) — ck:cook must not proceed until this is resolved.
_test_files: Every test file written or modified during --prepare. --tdd --verify diffs these exact files' current contents against this snapshot to detect weakening.
